title: Gummy Smile and Altered Passive Eruption Prevalence
official: Prevalence of Gummy Smile and Altered Passive Eruption in a Young Adult Population.
summary: This observational epidemiological study aims to assess the prevalence of gummy smile and altered passive eruption in a young adult population, with a focus on the second sextant. Periodontal and aesthetic parameters, along with patient-reported discomfort, will be analyzed to identify potential correlations and underlying anatomical factors.
